      3. Call this endpoint with the returned `filePath` and a `productId` to register the file as an asset

platforms.description: The platforms to scan in one call.

since.description: Lower bound on when a post was published, YYYY-MM-DD or a full ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. A topic scan covers the last 30 days when omitted; a handles scan covers the account’s latest posts.

limit.description: How many posts to keep across every platform, at most 30 (default 10).

sort.description: "trending" (velocity against age and the author’s audience, default for queries), "views", "engagement", or "recent" (default for handles).

candidates.description: Deduplicated, non-ad candidates kept for ranking

onTopic.description: Candidates the judge rated on-topic; null when no judge ran

providerCalls.description: Paid provider calls the scan spent

fitReason.description: Why the relevance judge kept this post, for a scan run with a brand.

trendScore.description: Velocity against the post’s age and its author’s audience.

kept.description: Posts kept after screening and ranking

urls.description: TikTok, Instagram or X post links, 6 at most. Short links are resolved.

productId.description: The brand the lookup is billed under, when there is one.

url.description: The TikTok, Instagram or X post link. Exactly one of url or postId.

postId.description: The postId of an Instagram or X post returned by this API (e.g. "x:1830000000000000000"). A TikTok post needs its url. Exactly one of url or postId.

productId.description: The brand the lookup is billed under, when there is one.

isPostAuthor.description: Written by the post’s own author

productId.description: The brand the imported assets are filed under.

assets.description: One asset for a video or photo post, one per slide for a carousel.

productId.description: The brand this search is for. Drives the fit screen and per-brand "already seen" memory.

platform.description: The platform to search. One platform per call.

keyword.description: What the creators post about, 1-4 words ("dog food reviews"). Exactly one of keyword or similarTo.

similarTo.description: A creator profile url (or @handle) to find lookalikes of. Exactly one of keyword or similarTo.

limit.description: How many creators to return (1-20, default 10).

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (common aliases like UK/USA accepted) to prefer one market.

cursor.description: The `nextCursor` of a previous result, to page the same search.

brief.description: One or two sentences on what the brand actually wants, for the fit screen.

language.description: ISO 639-1 code of the language the user writes in; `fitReason` is written in it. English when omitted.

faceless.description: "exclude" to drop faceless/AI-voiceover accounts, "include" to allow them.

gurus.description: "include" to allow coaches/agencies/course sellers, otherwise excluded by default.

avatarUrl.description: Signed url of the creator avatar, re-hosted by Arcads. Expires, so read it on the same call rather than storing it. Absent when no avatar could be re-hosted.

avatarPath.description: Never-expiring path of the creator avatar, relative to the API base url (`https://api.arcads.ai/v1`). It redirects to a fresh signed url, so it can be stored and embedded. Absent when no avatar could be re-hosted.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, when known.

viewRate.description: Median sample views divided by followers.

fitReason.description: What the fit screening found this account actually posts.

accountType.description: person, brand_page, agency_or_guru, faceless_or_ai, aggregator_or_repost, bot_or_spam, unknown.

degraded.description: True when this page came from a degraded fallback search.

handle.description: The creator's handle ("brewwithlena"), with or without the leading @.

prompt.description: The music to write, described by genre, mood, instrumentation and energy — not the sung words, which go in `lyrics`. Up to 1000 characters with Suno.
prompt.example: warm acoustic indie folk bed, light percussion, optimistic

model.description: The model. `elevenlabs` (default) writes exactly the requested length, 3-600s — the one for a bed that must run to the last frame of a video. `suno_v6` writes the richest tracks and takes sung `lyrics`; its length is approximate (20-360s) and it costs a flat 10 credits per two tracks.

duration.description: Length of the track in seconds: exact with `elevenlabs` (3-600), a target with `suno_v6` (20-360).

instrumentalOnly.description: True renders the track with no vocals, which is what a bed under a voiceover needs.

lyrics.description: Words to sing, up to 5000 characters. `suno_v6` only, with `instrumentalOnly` false. Section tags like [Verse] and [Chorus] are honoured.

nbGenerations.description: How many tracks to write. `suno_v6` returns two tracks per call, so two tracks cost the same as one.

referenceVideos.description: The links to source videos to edit or reference (conversational video editing / reference-to-video). You need to call GET v1/file-upload/get-presigned-url to get an upload presigned URL and a filePath. Then upload the videos to S3 using the presigned URL. Put the filePaths in the referenceVideos array.

startFrame.description: The link to the image used as the first frame of the generated video (can be combined with referenceImages). You need to call GET v1/file-upload/get-presigned-url to get an upload presigned URL and a filePath. Then upload the image to S3 using the presigned URL. Put the filePath in startFrame.
